this_court: The court follows the Third Circuit's reading in Bankoff and holds that 18 U.S.C. § 115(a)(1)(B) covers all individuals protected by 18 U.S.C. § 1114, including persons assisting federal employees.
quote: Indeed, adoption of the dissent's reading of the statutes would create an unwarranted circuit split, a result we understandably avoid if at all possible.
cite: United States v. Jacqueline Anderson, No. 20-50207 (9th Cir. 2022)
